summary.zh: 预测冲刺速度并评估团队健康度
summary.en: Forecast velocity, score sprint health and track retro actions.

description.zh: 基于历史数据预测冲刺速度与完成概率，评估冲刺健康度，把回顾会议的行动项整理成清单并跟踪落地。适合冲刺规划、迭代复盘或想找出阻塞来源时使用。
description.en: Forecasts sprint velocity and completion odds from history, scores sprint health, and turns retrospectives into tracked action items. Useful for sprint planning, retros and finding where work is stuck.
